as_told.title: Alien seen working alongside human staff at a facility

plain: During a classified mission at a military facility, Lyn Buchanan says he walked past a row of humans at work and saw among them one of "what they call the insectoids," an insect-like being. Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, tells it as something he saw, but hedges that "it could have been a soldier that just put on an alien hat," because the minute he saw it he looked away and kept walking. If it was what it seemed, it would mean a non-human being working alongside military staff.
